history.administration_response: The Office of Programme Planning, Budget and Accounts sends monthly reports on budget performance and has created a business intelligence platform web intelligence report that offers real-time business intelligence information on the status of budget implementation, open obligations and parked documents that require review by clients.
history.board_assessment: The Umoja business intelligence reports which have been generated track expenditures against allotments and are also capable of tracking open obligations. The Board expects that this functionality would further improve with the implementation of Umoja Extension 2. In view of the action taken by the Administration, the Board considers this recommendation as having been implemented.
